scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Hmm? What business do you have here?
If you wish to enter this sacred area,
you must give me your name and job level!
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
嗯？
你來這裡有什麼事？
想進入這片聖地，就必須報上姓名和職業等級！

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
....Eh?
Oh!^FF0000gosh^000000! I am sorry, I think I misunderstood you from someone I know.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
...咦？
哦！^FF0000天哪^000000！
抱歉，我好像把你認成了某個熟人。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
It is odd...I never misunderstand people...oh, well. Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
真奇怪...我從不認錯人啊...算了。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.translation:
[托霍布]

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 無視他

scripts.text: Tell him.
scripts.translation: 告訴他

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
To ignore another is disrespectful, get out!
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
無視別人，真沒禮貌！
出去！

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Hmm... {0} is your name?
...did I say it right?
Okay, and your job level is {1} correct?
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
嗯...你叫{0}？
...我念對了嗎？
好，你的職業等級是{1}，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Very well... why have you come here
{0}?
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
好吧...{0}，你來這裡有什麼事？

scripts.text: To visit and learn about monks.
scripts.translation: 參觀並瞭解武僧

scripts.text: I wish to become a monk...
scripts.translation: 我想成為武僧...

scripts.text: I'm tired and need to rest...
scripts.translation: 我累了，想休息一下...

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
I see...
We monks live our lives for spiritual enlightenment.
We improve our bodies as well as our minds to reach true inner peace.
May you find your inner peace as well.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
原來如此...
我們武僧畢生都在追求心靈的覺悟。
我們修煉身心，以求真正的內心平靜。
願你也能尋得內心的平靜。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Hmm you seem as though you have been training for this...
That is good. Go see our sensei Moohae. Speak with him.
He will help you start your training.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
嗯，看來你已經為此修煉了一段時間...
很好。
去找我們的武海師父談談吧。
他會指引你開始修行。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Hmm, you do not seem ready to become a monk.
To become a monk you must be,
at least a job level 40 Acolyte.
If not, you are not yet ready to become a monk.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
嗯，看來你還沒準備好成為武僧。
想成為武僧，你至少得是職業等級達到40的服事。
若未達到這個要求，就說明你還沒準備好。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Come back to me when you have trained more
and I will let you know if you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
再多修煉一段時間，然後來找我，我會告訴你是否已經準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
I hope that you will soon join us on our
path of inner peace and enlightenment.
I'll be waiting here for you.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
希望你能早日加入我們，一同踏上尋求內心平靜與覺悟的道路。
我會在這裡等你。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Hahahha that was a good joke!
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
Hahahha，這笑話真不錯！

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Yes, we all need to take a rest once in a while...
It is a good idea not to stress your self.
Come in and make yourself comfortable.
Rest as long as you need to.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
是啊，誰都需要偶爾休息一下...
別給自己太大壓力。
進來吧，放鬆些。
想休息多久都可以。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
I hope that you become energized
when observing our brothers in their
pursuit of spiritual enlightenment.
I hope you reach it too.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
希望你能從同門們追求心靈覺悟的修行中獲得力量。
也希望你能達到這樣的境界。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
What do you think? Did your visit reveal anything to your spirit?
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
感覺如何？這次來訪讓你心中有所感悟嗎？

scripts.text: No...
scripts.translation: 沒有...

scripts.text: I wish to become a monk.
scripts.translation: 我想成為武僧

scripts.text: I need to rest...
scripts.translation: 我需要休息...

scripts.text:

I hope that your experience here with
our brothers has helped you become one
step closer to true enlightenment.

希望你在這裡與同門們相處的經歷，能讓你離真正的覺悟更近一步。

scripts.translation:

旅途中要用心聆聽。
還有許多值得學習的東西。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Hmm... would you like to meet sensei Moohae?
He is in the south east area in 'The Hall of Monks'.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
嗯...你想見武海師父嗎？
他在“武僧大廳”的東南區域。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
I hope you do well in your training and I look forward to seeing you again.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
祝你修行順利，期待與你再次相見。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Welcome to the central chamber of our Church.
Please, try not to disturb the other monks.
Even if you are a monk yourself.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
歡迎來到我們教堂的中殿。
請儘量不要打擾其他武僧。
即使你自己也是武僧，也請遵守。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
How dare you set foot in
this holy building! ! !
Where is your respect?!
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
你竟敢踏入這座神聖的建築！！！
你還有沒有敬意？！

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Leave this place ! ! !
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
離開這裡！！！

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Hmmm... come in.
You may learn something...
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
嗯...進來吧。
你或許能學到些什麼...

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
Hmm.....you wish to see our sensei Moohae?
He is in the south east section of this building.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
嗯...你想見我們的武海師父？
他在這座建築的東南區域。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
I look forward to seeing you become a monk and joining us.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
期待你成為武僧，加入我們。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Greetings, you seem to be on a pure path.
Come in, come in, what can I do for you today?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你好，看來你走的是一條純淨之路。
進來吧，進來吧，今天有什麼需要我幫忙的？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
If you have free skill points, you will lose them during a job change.
Make sure to use any skill points you have.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
如果還有未使用的技能點，轉職時就會失去這些技能點。
務必先把所有技能點用完。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I sense a fighting spirit, do you wish to become a monk?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
我感受到了一股戰鬥意志，你想成為武僧嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
My apologies... It has been some time since
I have sensed someone with your strength.
I hope you find your path young one.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
抱歉...我已經很久沒遇到像你這樣有實力的人了。
年輕人，願你能找到自己的道路。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
There are still those who wish to follow the old ways.
A strong young man. I am pleased of your will to join us.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
看來還是有人願意傳承古老的修行之道。
真是個健壯的小夥子。
很高興你願意加入我們。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
There are still those who wish to follow the old ways.
Such a delicate flower. I am pleased to see your will to join us.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
看來還是有人願意傳承古老的修行之道。
真是朵嬌嫩的花兒。
很高興你願意加入我們。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Oh, you are the new pupil that wishes to join us...
Well there are a few things that you should know prior to beginning your training.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
哦，你就是想加入我們的新弟子...
開始修行之前，有幾件事你需要了解。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
We monks are on a path of inner peace and enlightenment.
We strive to bring such peace to all others with great care.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
我們武僧追求內心的平靜與覺悟。
我們也用心努力將這份平靜帶給所有人。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
We monks achieve this from mental and physical training.
We search for enlightenment in our surroundings and in nature.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
我們武僧通過身心的修煉來達到這一境界。
我們在身邊的事物和自然中尋求覺悟。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
It is, of course, important to always keep our original faith in God.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
當然，始終堅守對上帝最初的信仰也很重要。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
This is not an easy life and the true test of becoming a monk is having the ability to endure all of which I said...
The life of a monk is not for everybody, only those strong enough can become a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
這條修行之路並不輕鬆，能否承受我剛才所說的一切，才是成為武僧的真正考驗...
武僧的生活並非人人都能適應，只有足夠堅強的人才能成為武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Now, that you understand all of this,
prepare yourself to train
your strength and spirit.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
既然你已經明白了這一切，就準備好錘鍊你的力量與心志吧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Let us start with a simple task.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
先從一個簡單的任務開始吧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
{0} {1},
{2} {3},
{4} {5}.
Find these items and return to me.
[Sensei Moohae]
scripts.translation: [武海師父]

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Why the face? This is a test of your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
怎麼露出這副表情？
這是對你能力的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
What's wrong? This is a test of your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
怎麼了？
這是對你能力的考驗。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You do understand don't you? This is a test of your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你明白吧？
這是對你能力的考驗。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[武海師父]

要認真對待。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
It is a test of your abilities so make sure you acquire these on your own.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
這是對你能力的考驗，所以務必要靠自己取得這些物品。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Don't be concerned, I believe you can do it. This is only to test your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
別擔心，我相信你能做到。
這只是對你能力的一次考驗。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
If you are unable to return with these items, you are not yet ready to become a monk.
Be sure to collect all the items I listed.
May God be with you.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
如果你無法帶回這些物品，就說明你還沒準備好成為武僧。
務必收集齊我列出的所有物品。
願上帝與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You are back, did you bring what I asked?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你回來了，我要的東西帶齊了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Well done, you found all the items.
I will tell this to the elders.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
做得好，你找到了所有物品。
我會向長老們彙報這件事。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Let's see who is to see you next..
Ah... go find elder Touha.
He is in the north west.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
讓我看看接下來該讓你去見誰...
啊...去找陶哈長老吧。
他在西北方。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
How can you think to be done?
You do not have what I asked for!
5 Sticky Mucus,
10 Earthworm Peeling,
20 Green Herb.
These are the items I require, go find them all.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你怎麼就以為任務完成了？
我要的東西還沒帶齊呢！
5個粘稠液體，
10個蚯蚓皮，
20個綠色藥草。

5個賽依伐，

scripts.translation:

10個蝙蝠牙，
5個熊掌，
20個毒魔菇芽孢。
這些都是我要的物品，去全部找齊吧。

scripts.text:

Welcome back.
scripts.translation:

歡迎回來。

scripts.text:

Wow, you found all the items!!

scripts.translation:

啊...去找陶哈長老吧。

scripts.text:

You do not have what I asked for!
5 Porcupine Quill,
20 Cobweb,
10 Bug Leg.
These are the items I require, go find them all.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你怎麼就以為任務完成了？
我要的東西還沒帶齊呢！
5個刺蝟尖刺，
20個蜘蛛網，
10個蝗蟲後腿。
這些都是我要的物品，去全部找齊吧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I told you already.
Go find ^CC0000Touha^000000.
He is a little north west of here.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
我已經告訴過你了。
去找^CC0000陶哈^000000。
他就在這裡稍往西北的地方。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Oh, are you still in the process of training?
Hurry and finish!
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
哦，你還沒完成修行嗎？
快去完成吧！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I hear good things coming from your training.
Good luck and work hard. You will do great things as a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
聽說你的修行進展不錯。
祝你好運，繼續努力。
你一定會成為大有作為的武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
.......Hmmm.....
Go to Tomoon, get a special potion from him. It will look like a green potion, but it isn't. Bring it to me...
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
...嗯...
去找托蒙，向他取一瓶特殊藥水。
那藥水看起來像綠色藥水，但其實不是。
把它帶給我...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Do you still have the medicine you were supposed to bring?
You must drink that green potion to strengthen yourself for becoming a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
讓你帶來的藥水還在嗎？
你必須喝下那瓶綠色藥水，增強自身，為成為武僧做好準備。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Have you finished the task? Good, so you do have what it takes to become a monk.
You didn't throw away the precious potion did you?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
任務完成了嗎？
很好，看來你確實有成為武僧的潛質。
你沒把那瓶珍貴的藥水扔掉吧？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
The potion you drank earlier must be taking its effect by now.
Now that you drank the potion your training to become a monk will begin shortly...
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你剛才喝下的藥水，現在應該開始生效了。
既然已經喝下藥水，你的武僧修行很快就會開始...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
But first, answer me these questions.
Do you dedicate the remainder of your life to the pursuit of purity?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
不過，先回答我幾個問題。
你願意用餘生追求純淨嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
....with that kind of reply...
Have you not enough heart to become a monk?
Do you feel you have not suffered enough?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
...竟然這樣回答...
你難道沒有成為武僧的決心嗎？
還是覺得自己受的苦還不夠？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Think about it a little more and return!
We cannot accept a monk who is tainted with doubt...
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
再好好想想，然後回來！
我們不能接受心存疑慮的武僧...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you take advantage of the abilities gained through our training to use for personal benefit?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你會用修行所得的能力謀取私利嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
...then we cannot accept you as a monk. We, monks do not practice for personal benefit.
We lead our lives honorably and as holy executioners to the damned.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
...那我們就不能接受你成為武僧。
我們武僧修行，不是為了謀取私利。
我們以榮耀為準則而活，是處決受詛咒者的神聖行刑者。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Go back where you're from and reconsider what it means to be a monk...
How you stand before me now, you will never last as a monk and will be tainted by that which is evil...
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
回到你來的地方，重新想想成為武僧意味著什麼...
以你現在的心態，絕不可能堅持武僧的修行，只會被邪惡侵蝕...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you punishing those who are against
veritas and aequitas? ^CCCCCC(Truth and Justice)^000000
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你願意懲罰那些違背veritas與aequitas的人嗎？^CCCCCC（真理與正義）^000000

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Who do you think we, the monks are for!
Any creature that is against the will of such spawns from the dregs of the world!
They are not worthy to exist!
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你以為我們武僧是為了什麼而存在的！
任何違背真理與正義的生物，都是世界渣滓所生的汙穢之物！
它們不配存在！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Return when you are ready to face and eliminate that which is evil.
Then you will know what you have to do next without my instructions.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
等你準備好面對並消滅邪惡，再回來。
到那時，無須我指點，你也會知道接下來該做什麼。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you cooperate with others who have the same goal as yours and sacrifice yourself as a means to an end?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你願意與志同道合的人攜手，併為達成共同的目標而犧牲自己嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Did you say no...? This is unacceptable...
If you can help your comrades by sacrificing yourself that is a true display of purity.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你說不...？
這可不行...
若能犧牲自己來幫助同伴，那才是真正純淨的表現。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Go back and contemplate upon what it means to sacrifice yourself for those you care for.
Sacrificing yourself for others may seem easy, but it's the most difficult thing to do as a human being.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
回去好好想想，為你在乎的人犧牲自己意味著什麼。
為他人犧牲自己，看似容易，卻是人最難做到的事。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you assist your comrades by gathering monsters to follow you?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你會把魔物聚集起來，引著它們跟隨你，以此幫助同伴嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
That is not acceptable. Purposely taunting monsters to follow you can be very dangerous and harmful to others. This is not the way of a monk.
... that behavior is regarded as careless and is not tolerated.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
這可不行。
故意挑釁魔物，讓它們跟隨自己，既危險，又可能危害他人。
這不是武僧之道。
...這種行為太過魯莽，我們絕不容許。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Even though you may be nearly invincible when hardening your body that skill is meant to be used for emergency situation not to be used for such disrespectful use!
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
即使你能讓身體變得堅不可摧，近乎無敵，那項技能也是用來應對危急情況的，絕不能用於這種無禮之舉！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You might feel that's helping others, but it's not true.
Consider what it is you must do as a monk for others again.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你也許覺得這是在幫助別人，其實不然。
再好好想想，身為武僧，你究竟該為他人做些什麼。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you yell and shout the same things over and over again in towns or in fields?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你會在城鎮或野外反覆高聲喊同樣的話嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You are not allowed to do so. This doesn't apply only to monks but to everyone.
Nobody wants their peace disturbed!
Even if you mean well by it, it is disrespectful and not allowed.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
不許這樣做。
這不只是武僧的規矩，每個人都該遵守。
誰也不願被打擾安寧！
即使你出於好意，這也是無禮之舉，絕不容許。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Are you willing to die for others on your monk's path of being a holy executioner?
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
作為武僧，你將踏上神聖行刑者之路，你願意為他人獻出生命嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You cannot become a monk with such an attitude!!!
If we can eliminate at least one more enemy of ours by sacrificing ourselves, that's what is expected of you as a holy executioner in whom we are trained to be.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
抱著這種態度，你不可能成為武僧！！！
哪怕犧牲自己只能多消滅一個敵人，也該挺身而出，這正是我們修行成為神聖行刑者後應盡的職責。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
If you are unwilling to sacrifice yourself for those you care about,
how can you expect to reach true enlightenment?
Ponder upon the real meaning of life and death!!
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
如果你不願為在乎的人犧牲自己，又怎能獲得真正的覺悟？
好好思考生與死的真正意義！！

scripts.text: Lastly, make your oath that you will keep these vows.
scripts.translation: 最後，立下誓言，承諾遵守以上誓約。

scripts.text: I vow to keep these oaths.
scripts.translation: 我發誓遵守這些誓約

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
..............

[Sensei Moohae]
Then your training isn't completed.
You will not be accepted as a monk my boy.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
那麼，你的修行還沒有完成。
小夥子，我們還不能接納你成為武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Then your training isn't completed.
You will not be accepted as a monk little girl.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
那麼，你的修行還沒有完成。
小姑娘，我們還不能接納你成為武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
In light of this, your training will start again from the beginning....
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
既然如此，你的修行就得從頭開始...

scripts.text:
Calm down yourself... I reconsidered... perhaps you are simply not ready for the commitment yet.
Come back later when you're ready...
scripts.translation:
先冷靜一下...我又想了想...也許你只是還沒準備好作出這份承諾。
等準備好了再來吧...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I hope that you are able to realize what you are to become soon my boy...
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
小夥子，希望你能早日明白自己將要成為什麼樣的人...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I hope that you are able to realize what you are to become soon my girl...
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
姑娘，希望你能早日明白自己將要成為什麼樣的人...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Then your training is complete...
Please come closer.
We welcome you brother, in our holy battle against evil!
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
那麼，你的修行已經完成...
請走近些。
兄弟，歡迎你加入我們，共同投身對抗邪惡的神聖之戰！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Then your training is complete...
Please come closer.
We welcome you sister, in our holy battle against evil!
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
那麼，你的修行已經完成...
請走近些。
姐妹，歡迎你加入我們，共同投身對抗邪惡的神聖之戰！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
My brother, your oath has been heard by all around us.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
兄弟，在場的所有人都聽到了你的誓言。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
My sister, your oath has been heard by all around us.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
姐妹，在場的所有人都聽到了你的誓言。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I will now perform the ultimate techniques upon your body...
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
現在，我將對你施展至高秘技...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I will use these ancient techniques to amplify your strength through the use of pressure points on your body.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
我將用這些古老的技法，刺激你身上的穴位，增強你的力量。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Close your eyes.........
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
閉上眼睛...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
And relax your body.......
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
放鬆身體...

scripts.translation:

Haa~ Haa~ Haa~!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
Haa~ Haa~ Haa~!!!!!

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
.... now open your eyes......
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
...現在睜開眼睛...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
....and see life through the eyes of a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
...用武僧的眼光去看待生命。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
....You are a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
...你已經是一名武僧了。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
...heh.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
...heh.

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Well...I guess I am too old to do that anymore...I was better when I was younger...
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
唉...看來我老了，已經不適合施展這一招了...年輕時可比現在強多了...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
...anyways, you are a monk now.
Welcome!
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
...總之，你現在已經是一名武僧了。
歡迎加入！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I hope you will keep your vow..
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
希望你能堅守誓言...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
continue your training on your path and practice harder.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
沿著自己的道路繼續修行，更加刻苦地磨練自己。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Now...you may leave where the wind may take you.
Oh and I have a gift for you before you leave.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
現在...你可以隨風遠行了。
哦，臨行前，我還有一份禮物送給你。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You are...an acolyte..?
If you seek consultation, go to the Sanctuary in Prontera. This place is for Monks, not for you.
Unless you intend to become a monk....please leave.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
你是...服事...？
若想尋求指點，請去普隆德拉的聖堂。
這裡是武僧修行的地方，不適合你。
除非你打算成為武僧...否則請離開。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
How's your practice going?
I hope you are still training and keeping your vows.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
修行進展如何？
希望你仍在勤加修煉，堅守誓言。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
We must always continue our training in life and stay true to our path.
Otherwise evil will come and taint our mind with impurities.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
我們必須終生修行，始終堅守自己的道路。
否則，邪惡就會趁虛而入，玷汙我們的心靈。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Don't forget your vows, stay on your path and
do not let any evil taint your pure heart.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
不要忘記誓言，堅守自己的道路，不要讓任何邪惡玷汙你純淨的心。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
If you seek consultation, go to the Sanctuary in Prontera.
We do not have anything of interest to you here, please leave and do not disturb the other monks.
scripts.translation:
[武海師父]
若想尋求指點，請去普隆德拉的聖堂。
這裡沒有你感興趣的東西，請離開，不要打擾其他武僧。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
What brings you to me.
Do you wish to share a conversation with me?
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
你找我有什麼事？
想和我聊聊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Oh, I see. You're on the monk in training.
You already possess a similar spirit as a monk's.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
哦，原來如此，你正在進行武僧的修行。
你已經有幾分武僧的心志了。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
By the looks of you, it seems, you
have already visited Sensei Moohae. Good.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
看你的樣子，應該已經見過武海師父了。
很好。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Let me inform you about certain things you must know as a monk.
Then I will help you to strengthen your body so that you can bear your next training.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我先告訴你一些武僧必須瞭解的事。
然後，我會幫你強化身體，讓你能夠承受接下來的修行。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Calm your mind.
Relax your body...are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
靜下心來。
放鬆身體...準備好了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Please come back when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
準備好了再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Ok...then.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
好...那麼。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Please repeat after me.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
請跟我念。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Now, pay attention this time...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
這次可要聽仔細了...

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...

[Touha]
Hmm...

[Touha]
...well done, that was perfect. You pay attention well...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
...很好，背得一字不差。
看來你聽得很認真...

scripts.text:
[Touha]
However, now is not the time to relax. Your path is still long ahead of you.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
不過，現在還不是鬆懈的時候。
你還有很長的路要走。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Now as I promised, I will help strengthen your body.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
現在，我會履行承諾，幫你強化身體。

scripts.text: Focus your mind and do not move.
scripts.translation: 集中精神，不要動。

scripts.text: ^33CCFFYou feel wind all around your body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^33CCFF你感到周身環繞著風。^000000

scripts.text: ^33CCFFAn energy within you grows.^000000
scripts.translation: ^33CCFF你體內的一股力量正在壯大。^000000

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I feel what grows within you.
You may now continue on...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我感受到了你體內逐漸壯大的力量。
你可以繼續下一階段的修行了...

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...the next course will be with Boohae.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
...下一課將由布海負責。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I wish you well on your journey.
Don't forget, his name is ^CC0000Boohae^000000.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
祝你在旅途中一切順利。
別忘了，他的名字是^CC0000布海^000000。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I see you did not pay attention.. If you wish to become a monk, you must take this seriously.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
看來你沒有專心聽講...
想成為武僧，就必須認真對待。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Perhaps the path of a monk is too difficult for you?
You must take this seriously if you wish to continue...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
也許武僧的道路對你來說太難了？
如果你想繼續下去，就必須認真對待...

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I will give you another chance.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我再給你一次機會。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
If you cannot pay attention and repeat what I ask you to, I will not allow you to continue your training here..
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
如果你不能專心聽講、按我的要求複述誓言，我就不會讓你繼續在這裡修行...

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Hmm... did you forget who to visit?
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
嗯...你忘了該去找誰了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I wonder about your abilities if you cannot remember such a simple thing.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
連這麼簡單的事都記不住，我真要懷疑你的能力了。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...are you testing my patience?
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
...你是在考驗我的耐心嗎？

scripts.text:
[Touha]
You wear my patience thin...
... go visit Boohae.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我的耐心快被你耗盡了...
...去找布海。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...do your best for the final test.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
...在最後的測試中盡力吧。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Never shall innocent blood be shed.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
絕不可讓無辜之人流血。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Yet the blood of the wicked shall flow like a river.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
但邪惡之人的鮮血將如河流般奔湧。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
We shall spread our blackened wings and be the vengeful striking hammer of god.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我們將展開漆黑的雙翼，化作上帝懲戒仇敵的戰錘。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
We shall flow a river forth to thee, and teeming with souls shall it ever be.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我們將匯成河流奔向您，這河流將永遠滿載靈魂。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti.

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...You don't have to be afraid of me...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
...你不必害怕我...

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
...

[Boohae]
......
...excuse me...?

[Boohae]
...
You just interrupted my meditation, I should break your legs...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
...
你竟敢打斷我的冥想，真該打斷你的腿...

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
........
I will give you a chance to explain why you interrupted me.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
...
我給你一次機會，解釋為什麼打斷我。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
.....

[Boohae]
Well, start explaining... or you'll be crawling soon...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
好了，快解釋...不然你很快就只能爬著走了...

scripts.text: Touha sent me.
scripts.translation: 是陶哈派我來的

scripts.text: Sorry, nothing.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，沒什麼事

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
........
...you must have a death wish to have interrupted me intentionally...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
...
...故意打斷我，你是活膩了吧...

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
I see...
Well then, let's see....
scripts.translation:
[布海]
原來如此...
那麼，讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
....your body seems..
strengthened. Good...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
...你的身體似乎變強了。
很好...

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
What did you do with Touha?
scripts.translation:
[布海]
你和陶哈做了什麼？

scripts.text: Umm... well...ah..
We recited a holy pledge.
scripts.translation: 我們誦讀了神聖的誓言

scripts.text: He diagnosed my physical status.
scripts.translation: 他檢查了我的身體狀況

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
You are not ready if you
cannot answer a simple question.
Leave me to my prayers.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
連這麼簡單的問題都答不上來，說明你還沒準備好。
讓我繼續祈禱吧。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
... I see...
Didn't he do anything for you?
scripts.translation:
[布海]
...我明白了...
他難道沒為你做點什麼嗎？

scripts.text: Umm... well...ah..
He diagnosed my physical status.
scripts.translation: 他檢查了我的身體狀況

scripts.text: He taught me about being a monk.
scripts.translation: 他教了我武僧之道

scripts.text: He modified my body.
scripts.translation: 他改造了我的身體

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
You are not ready if you
cannot answer a simple question.
Leave me to my prayers.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
連這麼簡單的問題都答不上來，說明你還沒準備好。
讓我繼續祈禱吧。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
That is unimportant to me...
Stop disturbing me and go away!
scripts.translation:
[布海]
這對我來說並不重要...
別再打擾我了，快滾！

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
The teachings of becoming a monk are learned after becoming one.
This is not what I am looking for...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
武僧之道，要等成為武僧後再學。
我問的不是這個...

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Very well, you seem to realize your body has something new inside.
Well then, we shall move on to the next step...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
很好，看來你已經察覺到體內多了一股新的力量。
那麼，進入下一步...

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
...You interrupted me to tell me that...?
Get lost before I break your legs...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
...你打斷我，就是為了告訴我這個...？
在我打斷你的腿之前趕緊滾...

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Alright... well we have two tests...
Choose which one you want to do...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
好吧...有兩項測試可供選擇...
選一項你想參加的...

scripts.text: Gathering mushrooms
scripts.translation: 採集蘑菇

scripts.text: Marathon
scripts.translation: 馬拉松

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Hmm....gathering mushrooms. So you want to test your tolerance huh?
Go prepare and come back later when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
嗯...採集蘑菇。
看來你想考驗自己的忍耐力？
先去準備，準備好了再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Good choice. Forcing your physical limits to their boundaries and grants a higher amount of self control.
Go prepare and come back later when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
選得不錯。
挑戰身體的極限，能讓你更好地掌控自己。
先去準備，準備好了再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
So, are you ready? You won't need anything but a great deal of determination.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
那麼，準備好了嗎？
你什麼都不需要帶，只要有足夠堅定的意志。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
The gathering mushroom test is intended,
to test your patience.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
採集蘑菇的測試是為了考驗你的耐心。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Go inside the building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
去這座修道院附近的那棟建築裡。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Other monk candidates will be with you for the same test,
scripts.translation:
[布海]
其他準備成為武僧的人，也會和你一起參加這項測試。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
The more people that are there, the less mushrooms they'll find.
So I hope you will understand that they are testing their patience, just like you.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
那裡的人越多，能找到的蘑菇就越少。
所以我希望你能理解，他們和你一樣，也在考驗自己的耐心。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Welcome back, did you prepare? You won't need anything except strong legs.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
回來了，準備好了嗎？
你什麼都不需要帶，只要有強健的雙腿。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
The marathon is intended,
to test your self-control ability.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
馬拉松是為了考驗你的自控能力。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Go inside the building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
去這座修道院附近的那棟建築裡。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
All you have to do is run around the building as many times as you're required.
Well... get going.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
你只需繞著那棟建築跑完規定的圈數。
好了...去吧。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Now, go visit 'Tomoon'. How many times should I tell you this?
Now you have a lot of chance to damage your body because you're so exhausted right now.
'Tomoon' is staying in a deepest place inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
去找托蒙。
這話還要我說多少遍？
你現在已經精疲力竭，很容易受傷。
托蒙就在這座修道院附近那棟建築的最深處。

scripts.text: -He seems to be in meditation.-
scripts.translation: -他似乎正在冥想。-

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Hmmmm....!!
scripts.translation:
[布海]
Hmmmm....!!

scripts.text: -He seems to be in meditation.-
scripts.translation: -他似乎正在冥想。-

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
....this place is for those
 in testing for becoming a monk.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 喬裡普]
...這裡是武僧轉職測試的場所。

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Huh? Did you just say Boohae?
scripts.translation:
[守護者 喬裡普]
咦？你剛才說的是布海？

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Boohae... tends to hide in some quite places, so you might not be able to find him. For instance... a corner...
scripts.translation:
[守護者 喬裡普]
布海...喜歡躲在安靜的地方，你可能不太容易找到他。
比如...某個角落...

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Is your name {0}?
scripts.translation:
[守護者 喬裡普]
你的名字是{0}？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Alright you're cool... go on in. Your test is waiting for you. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 喬裡普]
好，沒問題...進去吧。
測試正等著你。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Yeah right, I know who you are... get in there... your test is ready.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 喬裡普]
得了吧，我知道你是誰...進去吧...測試已經準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
...please be quiet inside.
scripts.translation:
[守護者 喬裡普]
...進去後請保持安靜。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
So, which test do you want to do...?
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
那麼，你想參加哪項測試...？

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
From what I've heard, you chose the mushroom test...
Oh well, it's still your choice.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
聽說你選了採集蘑菇的測試...
不過，還是由你自己決定。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Which test hall do you wish to enter?
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
你想進入哪個測試大廳？

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Well, as far as I've been told, you chose the marathon test...
Oh well, it's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
聽說你選了馬拉松測試...
不過，還是由你自己決定。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Which test hall do you wish to enter?
You can choose which one you want.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
你想進入哪個測試大廳？
選你想去的就好。

scripts.text: Tolerance - Gathering Mushrooms
scripts.translation: 忍耐 - 採集蘑菇

scripts.text: Self-Control - Marathon
scripts.translation: 自控 - 馬拉松

scripts.text: You have decided to take the test of tolerance by ^FF0000gathering mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation: 你決定通過^FF0000採集蘑菇^000000來接受忍耐測試。

scripts.text: You have decided to take the test of self control by taking a ^FF0000marathon^000000.
scripts.translation: 你決定通過^FF0000馬拉松^000000來接受自控測試。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Welcome... this place is a training place for monks, Saint Capitolina Abbey.
When you go inside....you will meet Tomoon the oldest monk who succeeds to the predecessors,
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
歡迎...這裡是武僧的修行之地，聖卡波利納修道院。
進去後...你會見到托蒙，他是這裡最年長的武僧，繼承了前輩的衣缽。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Please be advised and do not touch anything.
And please avoid talking loud in front of Tomoon.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
請留意，別亂碰任何東西。
在托蒙面前也不要大聲喧譁。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
I hope you will have a great time in here.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
希望你在裡面度過愉快的時光。

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
W... welcome!
Th... this place is for testing the tolerance of monk candidates!
scripts.translation:
[武僧學徒]
歡...歡迎！
這...這裡是測試武僧候選人忍耐力的地方！

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
Ju... just run...
until you're told to stop,
Ru...ruu....run!
scripts.translation:
[武僧學徒]
跑...跑就對了...在有人叫停之前，跑...跑...跑！

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
M... m... me? I'll run one of these days!
scripts.translation:
[武僧學徒]
我...我...我？我總有一天也會跑的！

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
M... monk... are you going to be... a... m...m...monk??
scripts.translation:
[武僧學徒]
武...武僧...你要成為...一...一...一名武僧嗎？

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
Ar...are...you...sure you are.. aren't... going to quit?
scripts.translation:
[武僧學徒]
你...你...確定你...不會...放棄嗎？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Keep running.
scripts.translation: 繼續跑

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
{0}...q.q..q. .quit! ...the marathon!! Y...you do not have what it takes to be a m... monk!
scripts.translation:
[武僧學徒]
{0}...放...放...放棄了！...放棄馬拉松了！！
你...你沒有成為武...武僧的資質！

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
Until you're told to stop,
Ru...ruu....run!
scripts.translation:
[武僧學徒]
在有人叫停之前，跑...跑...跑！

scripts.text:
[Supervisor]
Now...you may go visit Tomoon.
Tomoon is in the deepest room inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[主管]
現在...你可以去找托蒙了。
他在這座修道院附近那棟建築最深處的房間裡。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
You didn't bring enough mushrooms... go get some more.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
你帶的蘑菇不夠...再去採一些。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Or is it you want to quit... do you want to quit?
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
還是說你想放棄...你是想放棄嗎？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Then move!
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
那就快走！

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
.....I figured as much....you don't have a spirit.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
...我就知道...你缺乏毅力。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Nice to meet you. My name is Hyunmoo. I am in charge of the mushroom test.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
幸會，我是玄武，負責採集蘑菇的測試。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Your task will be to gather mushrooms.
Understand?
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
你的任務是採集蘑菇。
明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Picking the mushrooms is to train your tolerance.
We planted a garden in order to survive as well as to discipline our minds.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
採摘蘑菇是為了鍛鍊你的忍耐力。
我們開闢菜園，既是為了生存，也是為了磨練心智。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
I believe there is no better way to find true inner peace then to be one with nature.
So we created our garden, however these mushrooms started sprouting up everywhere!
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
我相信，與自然合一，是尋得內心真正安寧的最佳途徑。
所以我們開闢了菜園，可這些蘑菇卻到處冒了出來！

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
What we ask of you as part of your training is to remove these mushrooms.
Go help the others remove as many mushrooms as you can and bring me back
enough ^FF0000Orange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^FF0000Orange Gooey Mushroom^000000 as proof.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
作為你訓練的一部分，我們要求你清除這些蘑菇。
去幫其他人儘可能多地清除蘑菇，並帶回足夠的^FF0000毒香菇^000000和^FF0000惡臭香菇^000000作為證明。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Now, go get some mushrooms.
Check back with me when you have picked some, I will tell you if it is enough.
And remember, find peace when gardening.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
現在，去採些蘑菇吧。
採到一些後回來找我，我會告訴你夠不夠。
記住，要在園藝勞作中尋得內心的安寧。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
...or do you want to quit?
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
...還是說你想放棄？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Alright then, keep going.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
好吧，那就繼續。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
.....yeah I thought as much....you don't have the spirit needed to become a monk.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
...我就知道...你缺乏成為武僧所需的毅力。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
...hmm... not bad.
Ok, you passed.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
...嗯...不錯。
好，你通過了。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Go meet Tomoon for your next test.
Tomoon is staying in the deepest room inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
去找托蒙，接受下一項測試。
他在這座修道院附近那棟建築最深處的房間裡。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Didn't I tell you to go meet ^FF0000Tomoon^000000? Or do you want to pick some more mushrooms?
Tomoon is staying in the deepest room inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
我不是叫你去找^FF0000托蒙^000000嗎？
還是說，你想再採些蘑菇？
他在這座修道院附近那棟建築最深處的房間裡。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
As I see vegetables growing, I feel myself growing within.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
看著蔬菜生長，我也感到自己的內心在成長。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
As I see other monks working hard on growing vegetables,
it warms my heart to see others enjoying gardening as I do.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
看著其他武僧辛勤種菜，和我一樣享受園藝，我心裡就暖暖的。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
To be honest with you, I think gardening is the greatest thing ever...
We should give thanks to the brothers who prepare our food for us through their hard work.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
說實話，我覺得園藝是世上最棒的事...
我們應該感謝那些辛勤勞作、為我們準備食物的同門。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Don't forget to thank them as you go by for their hard work.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
路過時別忘了感謝他們的辛勤付出。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Didn't I tell you to go meet Tomoon? Or do you want to pick more mushrooms?
Tomoon is staying in the deepest room inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
我不是叫你去找托蒙嗎？
還是說，你想再採些蘑菇？
他在這座修道院附近那棟建築最深處的房間裡。

scripts.translation:

路過時別忘了感謝他們的辛勤付出。

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Welcome young one.
My name is Tomoon, I am in charge of the last test of spiritual training!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
歡迎，年輕人。
我是托蒙，負責心志修行的最後一項測試！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Now you don't need to be instructed any more than this:
^990000Terminate every living thing in your way!^000000 That's all!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
只需記住這一條：
^990000消滅所有擋在你面前的生物！^000000
就這麼簡單！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
While you're wandering around within the maze, if you encounter any evil creatures, just kill them! Release their tortured souls!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
在迷宮裡探索時，遇到邪惡的生物就殺掉它們！
讓它們飽受折磨的靈魂得到解脫！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Do not compare us to the weakling priests! We are monks and we will always be the strongest!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
別把我們和那些軟弱的牧師相提並論！我們是武僧，我們將永遠是最強的！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
We are not like priests who cower behind the strength of others!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
我們不像那些牧師，畏畏縮縮地躲在別人身後，依靠別人的力量！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Now, focus!! Keep your fists tight and your eyes open! It's time to show me what you got.
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
集中精神！！
握緊拳頭，睜大眼睛！
是時候讓我看看你的實力了。

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Let's see if you got what it takes to be a true monk!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
讓我看看你有沒有成為真正武僧的本事！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Hmm... you failed?
Cheer up! Failure is but a process to success!
Go! Start again! Kill them all!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
嗯...失敗了？
振作起來！失敗只是通往成功的過程！
去吧！再來一次！把它們全部殺掉！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Excellent job!!
I knew you'd make it through!
Now...I will give you a secret potion which will double your physical strength.
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
幹得漂亮！！
我就知道你能通過！
現在...我會給你一瓶秘藥，它能讓你體力翻倍。

scripts.text:
Drink this potion and you will be able to become a monk!!!
... now go back to sensei Moohae!!!
scripts.translation:
喝下這瓶藥，你就能成為武僧了！！！
...現在回去找武海師父吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
I already told you, go back to sensei Moohae!!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
我已經告訴過你了，回去找武海師父吧！！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
....be quiet.
.....

[Tomoon]
I will not allow anyone to cause any trouble in this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
我不允許任何人在這座修道院惹事。

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
You'd better not be thinking about causing any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
你最好別想著惹事。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
So, are you ready to undergo the spiritual training?
scripts.translation:
[監考員]
那麼，準備好接受心志修行了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 還沒有

scripts.text: What do I have to do?
scripts.translation: 我要做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
Alright! I wish you luck. If you get lost and can't find a way out, simply log out and log back in.
Then you will return to your save point. What's that mean? Heck if I know, I'm just told to say that. Oh yes and also, please cooperate with your comrades.
scripts.translation:
[監考員]
好！祝你好運。
如果迷路了，找不到出口，就退出遊戲後重新登入。
這樣就會回到存檔點。
這是什麼意思？我哪知道，我只是按吩咐這麼說罷了。
哦，對了，還請和同伴們互相配合。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
I see. Take your time.
scripts.translation:
[監考員]
明白了。請慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
Inside this test hall is the maze of spirits.
There are spirits inside which will block you from moving freely.
scripts.translation:
[監考員]
考場裡是一座靈體迷宮。
裡面的靈體會阻礙你的行動。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
If you want to exit the test hall, you must make your way to the warp portal located at the opposite side from the start point.
scripts.translation:
[監考員]
想離開考場，就得找到位於起點另一側的傳送門。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
....Oh yes and also there are monsters wandering around in the maze, please clear them.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[監考員]
...哦對了，迷宮裡還有魔物在遊蕩，請清理掉它們。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
You did well. Please return to Tomoon, he's waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[監考員]
做得很好。
回去找托蒙吧，他在等你。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
So, are you ready to undergo this spiritual training?
scripts.translation:
[監考員]
那麼，準備好接受這項心志修行了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text: No.

scripts.text:
Grrrr...
All monsters in the monk job chance place have been reset.
Timer's activated.
scripts.translation:
Grrrr...
武僧轉職測試場所的所有魔物已重置。
計時器已啟動。
